dataset_name: DT-CARGO: Dataset of Trucks' Anonymized Recorded Driving and Operation
lead_institution: Technical University of Munich (TUM), Institute of Automotive Technology (FTM)
authors: Gisela Balke, Leonard Adenaw, Markus Lienkamp
vehicle_type: Class N3 Heavy Commercial Vehicles (Articulated Trucks, 40 tonnes GCWR)
monitoring_duration: Up to 12 months (over 1.26 million km recorded)
key_parameters_logged: vehicle_id, tour_id, start_time, stop_time, distance, avg_speed, max_speed, signal loss, HDOP, gross vehicle weight, total mass with trailer
documented_limitations: Engine CAN bus signals (fuel rate, RPM, percent torque) anonymized/withheld due to commercial fleet NDA restrictions; fuel consumption derived via standardized vehicle energy equation

dataset_name: NREL Fleet DNA: Commercial Fleet Vehicle Operating Data Clearinghouse
lead_institution: National Renewable Energy Laboratory (NREL / NLR), U.S. Department of Energy
authors: Kenneth Kelly, Adam Duran, Eric Wood
publication_journal: NREL Technical Report / SAE International Technical Papers
zenodo_repository: Archived via DOE Office of Scientific and Technical Information (OSTI)
vehicle_type: Class 6 Medium Duty and Class 8 Heavy Duty Commercial Trucks
number_of_vehicles: Over 500 commercial vehicles across delivery, drayage, and vocational fleets
sampling_frequency: 1 Hz second-by-second telematics and engine CAN data
data_license: U.S. Government Public Sector Research License
access_mode: Restricted Access (Requires registration and institutional approval via Livewire/FleetREDI portal)
key_parameters_logged: Vehicle speed, engine RPM, torque %, instantaneous fuel rate (g/s), road grade, cumulative fuel, stops per mile
documented_limitations: Raw second-by-second micro-trip data requires individual user registration and login at livewire.energy.gov; automated bot retrieval disallowed

dataset_name: Oak Ridge National Laboratory Heavy-Duty Truck Duty Cycle Study
lead_institution: Oak Ridge National Laboratory (ORNL), Energy and Transportation Science Division
sampling_frequency: 1 Hz J1939 CAN bus data logger
key_parameters_logged: Gross combination weight, auxiliary aerodynamic skirts, fuel flow rate, transmission gear position, road gradient
documented_limitations: Data aggregated into trip summary tables in published supplementary appendices rather than continuous bulk CSV download

dataset_name: Scania Component X Multivariate Fleet Telemetry Dataset
vehicle_type: Scania R-series and G-series Heavy Duty Trucks
number_of_vehicles: Fleet of over 300 commercial heavy trucks
sampling_frequency: Aggregated daily operational bins and sensor histogram counters
key_parameters_logged: Operational hours, cumulative distance, engine temperature histograms, pressure counters, fuel consumption index
documented_limitations: Sensors and counters normalized into anonymized statistical histograms to protect Scania proprietary ECU firmware architectures

dataset_name: European Environment Agency (EEA) / EMEP Heavy-Duty Vehicle Emission & Fuel Factors
lead_institution: European Environment Agency (EEA) & Aristotle University of Thessaloniki (EMISIA)
publication_journal: EMEP/EEA Air Pollutant Emission Inventory Guidebook 2023
vehicle_type: Rigid and Articulated Commercial Trucks (3.5t to 50t GVW)
number_of_vehicles: Laboratory and portable emission measurement system (PEMS) tested fleets (> 200 trucks)
monitoring_duration: Chassis dynamometer cycles and real-world PEMS driving cycles
key_parameters_logged: Speed-dependent fuel consumption functions (L/100km = f(V, Payload, Gradient)), cold-start multipliers, road gradient correction factors
documented_limitations: Empirical curve formulations rather than individualized driver telemetry time-series

dataset_name: ARAI / MoRTH Commercial Vehicle Fuel Economy and Homologation Test Standards
lead_institution: Automotive Research Association of India (ARAI), Ministry of Heavy Industries
vehicle_type: Indian Commercial Vehicles (Tata, Ashok Leyland, Eicher, BharatBenz, Mahindra)
number_of_vehicles: All type-approved commercial vehicle models sold in India
sampling_frequency: Standardized Indian Driving Cycle (IDC) and World Harmonized Transient Cycle (WHTC)
key_parameters_logged: Brake specific fuel consumption (BSFC g/kWh), fuel consumption per tonne-km, maximum power and torque at rated RPM
documented_limitations: Indian commercial truck telemetry is maintained proprietary by fleet aggregators (e.g., Rivigo, Delhivery, BlackBuck) under strict non-disclosure commercial agreements; national public open telemetry clearinghouses do not currently exist in India
